title: Typewriter
description: x-typewriter types the element's text (or text) out one character at a time, speed milliseconds apart, with a blinking cursor unless cursor="false".

speed.description: Milliseconds between characters. Defaults to `50` — lower is faster.

text.description: Text to type out. Falls back to the element's existing `textContent`, so it can be left off when the content is already in the markup.

cursor.description: Show the blinking caret while typing. On by default; cursor="false" turns it off. It is a caret, not a character: its look comes from the stylesheet.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
